items.name: Boiled Egg
items.description: Boiled eggs are a great source of protein, healthy fats, vitamins (like B12 and D), and minerals (like iron and selenium).

items.name: Grilled Chicken
items.description: Both healthy and satisfying, grilled chicken is a go-to choice for fitness enthusiasts and food lovers alike.

items.name: Cake
items.description: Soft, moist, and often indulgent, cake is more than just a dessert—it's a mood-lifter and a party essential! 🎂

items.name: Burger
items.description: A good burger is all about that perfect bite—juicy, flavorful, and downright delicious! 🍔

items.name: Pancake
items.description: Pancakes are a breakfast favorite in many countries and can also be enjoyed as a snack or dessert.

items.name: Ramen
items.description: Ramen is a beloved Japanese noodle soup dish known for its rich, flavorful broth and chewy wheat noodles
